questions.stem: Explain the role of regular expressions in lexical analysis.
markingGuide: Regular expressions define patterns for tokens.
They help in identifying and classifying lexemes.
They are used to automate the tokenization process.
questions.explanation: Regular expressions are crucial in lexical analysis as they provide a formal way to specify patterns for different token types. This allows the lexer to efficiently identify and classify lexemes into tokens, automating the initial phase of compilation.

questions.stem: Discuss the importance of the maximal munch rule in token recognition.
markingGuide: Ensures the longest possible token is recognized.
questions.explanation: The maximal munch rule is vital in token recognition as it ensures that the longest matching sequence of characters is selected as a token. This prevents ambiguity, ensuring consistent and correct tokenization, which is crucial for the subsequent phases of compilation.
